title: Love laughs at locksmiths
html_source:
Love laughs at locksmiths

This means much the same as Love will find a way. The source is Venus and Adonis, the long poem by Shakespeare:
Were beauty under twenty locks kept fast,
Yet love breaks through, and picks them all at last.
http://proverbhunter.com/proverb/love-laughs-at-locksmiths/

Originated from an 1803 play by George Colman.
